sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification as a whole. It may not receive new business or new parts now, and moving BR-180 deliveries to Pinerolo is new business. No later document shows the status has changed.

sources.quote: Temporary permit to accept BR-180 brackets from Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C)

findings.why: No controlled record covers an approval of SUP-C for BR-180 at Pinerolo (PLT-PIN). The only BR-180 document is DEV-114, a temporary deviation for Beinasco that expired on 2025-06-30. Approval is per part, receiving plant and customer, so a person must confirm whether a current release exists. The customer is not stated in the documents. CUST-AUR is used only because Aurelia's resident engineer approved DEV-114.
